items.item_text: The minimum qualifications for service as an educational administrator shall be both of the following: Possession of a master's degree, AND One year of formal training, internship or leadership experience reasonably related to the administrator's administrative assignment,

as a community college EOPS counselor or EOPS instructor, or have comparable experience in working with disadvantaged clientele.
